title: Docutils文档发布工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：让真实CLI组件加载失败返回非零且诊断只写stderr；为RST提供真实表格节点及CSV边界的显式分段列表指令；让代码指令原生caption与真实高亮块具名关联并发布语义HTML；把显式可折叠提示发布为真实details summary并保留非HTML内容；给真实doctree提供白名单版本化JSON writer及受约束重建；按实际章节ID复制真实文档片段并显式处理外部脚注引用闭包。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Fix docutils.__main__.main ImportError handling so missing reader/parser/writer reports failure on stderr, exits nonzero and emits no stdout document/help hint or target artifact. Preserve explicit --traceback reraising with stack and normal successful HTML publication/exit. Do not swallow failures as success, change valid component selection or broadly catch arbitrary developer exceptions. Demonstrate actual python -m docutils subprocess behavior with isolated config.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_docutils_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-docutils-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.
